name: Alvar Lauren
source:
Affiliation: Elusion
Post: Helmsman
Birthplace: Italy (Milan)

A bit of a flirt who's used to talking with women.
A guy who can talk frankly with anyone.
He's good at doing small tasks that don't seem suited to his build, like embroidery and knitting.
